programme.title: Uunchai
programme.desc: When three retired friends go on a trek to the Everest Base Camp to fulfil their dying friend's last wish, they discover the true meaning of freedom and life.

programme.title: Nagin Ka Inteqam
programme.desc: A gang of poachers forcibly try to obtain a stone from two snakes and end up killing one while the other escapes. The second snake then uses a young girl to avenge the death of her partner.

programme.title: Sher Ka Shikaar
programme.desc: A man, who is famous in his village for killing man-eating tigers, unwillingly becomes a part of a conspiracy surrounding illegal drugs.

programme.title: The Faith Show
programme.desc: Romildo Ribeiro Soares, a Brazilian televangelist, stresses the importance of faith in the Almighty and urges devotees to walk the path of righteousness.

programme.title: Apna Sapna Money Money
programme.desc: Arjun and Shivani are in love, but Shivani's father will never let them marry each other. Later chaos ensues when Arjun enlists the help of his conman cousin, Kishan, to unite him with Shivani.

programme.title: Raksha Bandhan
programme.desc: Embracing his role as the provider, Lala Kedarnath puts personal romantic interests on the back burner until his quirky sisters can be married off into loving families.

programme.title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
programme.desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Yuvraj Vijay Singh, replaces him just before Vijay is to be crowned king. Although Vijay is engaged to Princess Maithili, she falls in love with Prem.

programme.title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
programme.desc: A man is challenged to work in a field and produce a huge harvest by the end of the season in order to marry the love of his life.

programme.title: Jai Ho
programme.desc: A former Indian military officer devises a unique plan to promote social responsibility amongst apathetic civilians. The masses embrace his initiative, but he must confront a potent political family.

programme.title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
programme.desc: Ramkishan and Mamta lead a happy life with their three sons. But when their daughter faces a tragedy, Mamta gets instigated by her close friends, and she embitters her heart towards her stepson Vivek.

programme.title: Bengal Tiger
programme.desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

programme.title: Aar Paar-The Judgement Day
programme.desc: Prudhvi and Shashank belong to rival gangs of the same college. However, when a local goon attempts to buy their college land, the two groups strive to work together to save their institute.

programme.title: Aattral
programme.desc: Arjun's father, who is a mechanic, manages to get INR 10 lakh to fulfil Arjun's dream of developing an automatic car. However, the former is robbed and killed by a mysterious man.

programme.title: Gabbar Sher 2
programme.desc: Tagore creates his vigilante military network or Anti-Corruption Force (ACF) with his former students to eliminate corruption in the society.

programme.title: The Faith Show
programme.desc: Romildo Ribeiro Soares, a Brazilian televangelist, stresses the importance of faith in the Almighty and urges devotees to walk the path of righteousness.

programme.title: Venky Mama
programme.desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

programme.title: Bhairathi Ranagal
programme.desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.

programme.title: Krrish
programme.desc: After discovering his father's truth, Krrish must reveal his superpowers to the world and becomes the masked superhero.

programme.title: Real Tevar
programme.desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

programme.title: Akhanda 2
programme.desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.

programme.title: Commando 3
programme.desc: Commando Karan Singh Dogra and Inspector Bhavna Reddy race against time to thwart a terrorist attack on India. Later, they realise that foiling mastermind Buraq's plan is harder than it seems.
